facts.text: Solaz sits on the coastline of Baja California Sur, between San José del Cabo and Cabo San Lucas, on the Sea of Cortez.
facts.excerpt: Ideally located between San...See More José del Cabo and Cabo San Lucas, our resort provides easy access to local attractions, dining and the marina while immersing guests in the beauty of the Sea of Cortez.

facts.text: The architecture is by Sordo Madaleno, with sculptures and art by César López-Negrete.
facts.excerpt: Architecture by Sordo Madaleno, and sculptures and art by César López-Negrete.

facts.text: The resort is designed in contemporary Mexican style using warm indigenous woods, and a wrapping infinity pool meets the stretch of sand.
facts.excerpt:
The resort is designed in contemporary Mexican style using warm indigenous
woods and tones to provide a transformative immersion into the local environment, while a wrapping infinity pool meets the endless stretch of sand.

facts.text: Its stone-and-glass structures are built low into the desert terrain, with commissioned Mexican art and native landscaping.
facts.excerpt: its stone-and-glass structures are built low into the desert terrain, with commissioned Mexican art and native landscaping

facts.text: Rooms are designed with local Mexican huanacaxtle wood and marble textures, and select accommodations have private plunge pools.
facts.excerpt: These sophisticated Los Cabos hotel rooms and suites also showcase private plunge pools in select accommodations, creating an elevated retreat along the Sea of Cortez.

facts.text: Many rooms and suites offer indoor-outdoor living with private terraces, outdoor showers, plunge pools and ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Many rooms and suites offer indoor-outdoor living with private terraces, outdoor showers, plunge pools and ocean views.

facts.text: The One Bedroom Ocean View Suite has a private balcony with a hammock and an outdoor hot tub.
facts.excerpt: Step onto your private balcony with a hammock for relaxation and an outdoor hot tub.

facts.text: Villa Solaz has four bedrooms, an expansive terrace and two family pools, with a private chef and dedicated artisan butler.
facts.excerpt: With four bedrooms, expansive terrace, and two family pools, this residence is ideal for extended stays, intimate gatherings, or multigenerational escapes.

facts.text: The Wellness Suite features a bed massage table and a private steam room.
facts.excerpt: The Wellness Suite features a bed massage table and a private steam room

facts.text: Ojo de Liebre Spa + Thalasso combines ancient wellness traditions, thalassotherapy and contemporary treatments, inspired by Baja's Ojo de Liebre lagoon.
facts.excerpt: Ancient wellness traditions, thalassotherapy, and contemporary treatments come together in a serene setting

facts.text: The spa has seawater and fresh water pools, 12 treatment rooms, hot and ice-cold tubs, aromatherapy, chromotherapy light showers and a Cryotherapy chamber.

facts.text: The infinity pools are designed with butterfly green granite that mirrors the turquoise waters beyond.
